links.comparator_used: The LLMs' original responses before reformulation; the P1 prompt (6th-grade level) was also compared with the P2 prompt (easier to understand, no grade level)
links.outcome: Change in readability after prompting for a 6th-grade reading level (P1) or easier text (P2)
links.effect: Readability improved for GPT-4.0 with both P1 and P2; no significant change for GPT-4o mini and Gemini. No numeric values are given in the abstract.
links.quote: Adjustments made in the P1 and P2 formats improved readability for GPT-4.0, while no significant change was observed for GPT-4o mini and Gemini.

design_hint: reading-level constraint prompts for patient materials
